decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Underworld Breach card in combination with various card draw and graveyard interaction cards to generate a powerful combo. The deck includes cards like Mishra's Bauble, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to help cycle through the deck quickly and find key combo pieces. The goal is to fill the graveyard with cards, then use Underworld Breach to cast multiple spells from the graveyard in a single turn, potentially dealing a large amount of damage to the opponent and overwhelming them with a flurry of spells.

The main concept of the deck revolves around aggressive plays with a focus on disrupting the opponent's hand and graveyard while utilizing cards like Fury, Ragavan, and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure and control the board. The deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence through a mix of efficient removal spells and evasive threats, supported by graveyard recursion and card advantage from cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck aims to win through a combination of early aggression and disruption, overwhelming the opponent before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to continuously recycle cards from the graveyard, generating card advantage and setting up explosive combos. It includes a mix of cheap spells, card draw, and creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly fill the graveyard and enable the combo. Teferi, Time Raveler is used to protect the combo and ensure it can be executed smoothly. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, powerful combo while using Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional consistency.

The deck focuses on assembling the Tron lands (Urza's Tower, Mine, Power Plant) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes control elements like counterspells (Condescend, Remand), removal (Repeal, Dismember), and versatile threats (Karn, the Great Creator, Shark Typhoon) to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win conditions, such as Mindslaver lock or Chalice of the Void on key cards. The deck can also utilize Academy Ruins to recur important artifacts and has access to alternate win conditions like Walking Ballista and Field of Ruin.

The deck focuses on cycling creatures with high mana costs to fill the graveyard quickly and then casting Living End to bring them all back into play for a massive board advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up for the combo. The key strategy is to efficiently cycle through the deck, control the opponent's resources, and then overwhelm them with a powerful board presence after resolving Living End.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the Cascade mechanic with cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cheat out powerful creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Striped Riverwinder. By cycling through cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will, the deck aims to fill up the graveyard quickly in order to cast Living End and bring back all the creatures to overwhelm the opponent. Force of Negation provides protection while Grief and Waker of Waves disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes some alternative win conditions like Boseiju, Who Endures and Otawara, Soaring City.

The deck combines powerful creatures with the ability to cheat them onto the battlefield quickly and disruptively. By using cards like "Indomitable Creativity" and "Wrenn and Six" to put creatures like "Archon of Cruelty" and "Wrenn and Realmbreaker" into play early, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to respond. Additionally, cards like "Persist" and "Invasion of Ergamon" provide backup plans and ways to recur threats if they are dealt with. The deck's strategy revolves around quickly assembling a game-winning board state through creative means.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through various cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Supreme Verdict while utilizing lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Scapeshift to deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Bring to Light and Wrenn and Six to help with consistency and resource management. The diverse mana base allows for flexibility in casting spells of multiple colors, while cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove help ramp up mana quickly. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through a combo of land triggers and sheer card advantage.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Ziatora's Proving Ground. By utilizing cards like Wrenn and Six, Prismari Command, and Fire / Ice for removal and control, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent while setting up its combo pieces. The inclusion of Dwarven Mine and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional ways to generate tokens and mana to support the combo. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its creative and explosive plays.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly control the board and reduce your own life total to boost the power of Death's Shadow. By utilizing a mix of disruption, card draw, and efficient creatures like Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while maintaining a strong defense. Stubborn Denial and Counterspell help protect your threats, while Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes some tempo plays with Brineborn Cutthroat and Brazen Borrower to help secure victory in a fast-paced format like Modern.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Wrenn and Realmbreaker. The deck also includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Persist to generate card advantage and fuel the combo. The inclusion of cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Fatal Push helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up your own win condition. Overall, the deck aims to be creative in its combo plays and generate explosive turns to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling a deadly combo involving Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip a massive creature with a powerful equipment such as Kaldra Compleat or Shadowspear. It also utilizes Stoneforge Mystic to tutor for key pieces and Urza's Saga to generate additional artifacts. The deck includes protection in the form of Esper Sentinel and Giver of Runes, along with early game aggression from cards like Ornithopter and Gingerbrute. With efficient mana production from Springleaf Drum and Inkmoth Nexus, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a lethal threat.

This deck utilizes equipment and creatures with low casting cost to assemble a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm opponents. By combining cards like Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid, the deck can create lethal threats early in the game. Additionally, cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga help to search for key pieces of the combo. The inclusion of protection spells like Spell Pierce and Giver of Runes ensures that the combo is not easily disrupted by opponent's removal.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cycling creatures and disruptive spells, then cast Living End to bring all those creatures back onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a massive army. The deck also includes countermagic and disruptive creatures to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The focus is on cycling as many cards as possible to set up the combo and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly pressure the opponent. It also includes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to deal with threats. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, while also generating card advantage with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. Additionally, Blood Moon can be used to shut down non-basic lands. Overall, the deck aims to win through quick and aggressive plays while controlling the game with disruption spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to combo off with Archon of Cruelty and Dwarvin Mine tokens, while also utilizing Wrenn and Six for recurring value. The deck also includes various spells like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce for interaction and disruption. The deck aims to creatively generate advantage through its unique combination of cards, creating powerful board states and overwhelming the opponent with its diverse range of threats and answers. It prioritizes flexibility and adaptability, making it a challenging and rewarding deck to pilot in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.
